newsitem.title: UK: SmithKline up after ADR gains, Kleinwort buy.
newsitem.headline: SmithKline up after ADR gains, Kleinwort buy.

text.p: SmithKline Beecham Plc was the biggest gainer in the FTSE 100 by early afternoon on Monday, echoing Friday's gains in its ADRs in New York and boosted by a broker recommendation, dealers said.
Analysts at Kleinwort Benson said SmithKline remained their favourite among top UK drug stocks and was preferred over Glaxo Wellcome Plc for its cheaper rating and superior growth prospects.
SmithKline shares were up 28-1/2p or 3.3 percent at 886 by 1325 GMT in volume of 2.0 million shares. In the U.S. on Friday its ADRs rose $2-1/8 to $71-3/4.
